hero.title: You Capture. AI Prioritizes.
hero.description: Create tasks by voice, from meetings, or from email. Every task gets an AI-calculated score that feeds directly into your schedule.

body: Every task receives two AI-calculated scores: importance (how much it matters to your goals) and urgency (how time-sensitive it is). The AI weighs deadlines, project health, dependencies, domain context, and your personal patterns. High-scoring tasks get scheduled first when the AI plans your day. Low-scoring noise stays out of your focus time. Tasks flow in from voice notes, meeting transcripts, emails, and agent output — you capture, HABOS prioritizes.
